map.乾卦六爻皆阳，爻题初九至上九：初九“潜龙勿用”、九二“见龙在田”、九三“君子终日: Qian's six lines are all yang, with titles from Initial Nine to Top Nine: Initial Nine 'the hidden dragon does not act', Second Nine 'the dragon appears in the field', Third Nine 'the noble-one toils all day', Fourth Nine 'he may leap into the abyss', Fifth Nine 'the flying dragon is in the heavens', Top Nine 'the arrogant dragon has regret'; plus 'Use Nine: see the flock of dragons without a head, auspicious'. The six lines show yang rising from hidden to extreme and then to 'fullness cannot last', a typical example for understanding the Zhouyi's line-position thought.
map.爻题里的“初九”“六三”怎么读？: How to read "Initial Nine" and "Third Six" in line titles?
map.爻题由“爻位+爻性”组成：初/二/三/四/五/上表从下往上的爻位，九=阳爻、六=: A line title combines 'line position + line nature': initial/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/top denote positions from bottom up, and nine = yang line, six = yin line. Thus 'Initial Nine' = the lowest yang line, 'Third Six' = the third yin line, 'Top Six' = the top yin line. To look up a line text, first fix the hexagram, then the moving line position.
map.为什么阳爻称“九”、阴爻称“六”？: Why is a yang line called "nine" and a yin line called "six"?
map.源于《周易》用“老阳九、老阴六”标记阴阳（与筮法过揲之数相关：老阳策数 36÷4: It originates from the Zhouyi marking yin-yang as 'old yang nine, old yin six' (related to the counting method: old yang stalks 36/4=9, old yin 24/4=6). Later generations used 'nine' for yang lines and 'six' for yin lines in line titles, corresponding one-to-one with the line images (— / --).
